title: CLSA Sanjeev Rana：AI推理带动CPU需求，存储产品全面受益？
speaker: Sanjeev Rana

segments.en: So as a result, we expect them to win win share. Sanjeev, I want to ask you about the risk to the overall memory thesis.
segments.zh: 因此，我们预计他们将赢得份额。Sanjeev，我想问你关于整体存储逻辑的风险。

segments.en: I'll use in a GPUs versus CPUs as an example in how many people say because of the changes in the technology and demands it's not CPUs more than GPUs.
segments.zh: 我以GPU与CPU为例，很多人说由于技术和需求的变化，CPU的需求增长超过GPU。

segments.en: The reason I just underscored that point is, are there any, are you watching any specific developments around a technology curve that could actually undermine the overall thesis on memory?
segments.zh: 我强调这一点的原因是，你是否在关注任何可能削弱整体存储逻辑的技术曲线发展？

segments.en: Yes, your right. CPUs are better for certain kind of workloads, especially in AI inference and agent AI.
segments.zh: 是的，你说得对。CPU更适合某些类型的工作负载，尤其是在AI推理和智能体AI中。

segments.en: So as a result, the demand for CPUs has exploded in the last one year or so.
segments.zh: 因此，过去一年左右CPU的需求爆发式增长。

segments.en: GPUs are more suitable for AI training. But the common theme here is that whether CPUs or GPUs, both of them need lots of memory.
segments.zh: GPU更适合AI训练。但共同点是，无论是CPU还是GPU，它们都需要大量存储。

segments.en: So GPUs need HBM and CPUs need more like a server DRAM, which is also a very high ASP product.
segments.zh: GPU需要HBM，而CPU更需要服务器DRAM，这也是一个非常高单价的产品。

segments.en: So overall, as long as the AI adoption continues to increase, I think we will have opportunities
segments.zh: 总体而言，只要AI采用率持续增长，我认为我们将有机会

segments.en: to sell all sort of memory products, whether it's HBMs, server DRAMs or enterprise SSDs in case of data centers.
segments.zh: 销售各种存储产品，无论是HBM、服务器DRAM还是数据中心的企业级SSD。

segments.en: So this memory, like AI industry is offering a lot of multi-growth opportunity for memory suppliers.
segments.zh: 因此，存储就像AI行业一样，为存储供应商提供了许多多元增长机会。
